featured_reviews.name: Ankur Gohil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Having met Aku from the SlumGods crew – a hip-hop collective empowering children through teaching them the elements of hip-hop in Dharavi, during the #sassoondockartproject, @guidovanhelten spent sometime in Dharavi, making photographs, and understanding more about the space through the eyes of Aku and his friends who gave him a first hand sense of the vibrant street culture of Dharavi.

The artist decided he wanted to paint two boys, Bboy Pro kid and Bboy Abhishek, framed mid-action doing what they do best … dance!

The mural is a representation of the future of youth culture and the strength of creativity and expression in Dharavi through dance, graffiti and hip hop culture. It is reflective of the emerging and contemporary face of Dharavi.

It is a must visit place for everyone to witness the mural in person

featured_reviews.name: dpparikh1
featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly Disappointing and Unacceptable Experience

This builder has been a constant source of trouble. They overcharge without justification and provide confusing and inconsistent payment statements, making it unclear what is actually payable at any point.

They repeatedly send incorrect reminders demanding interest, even when payments have been made, and fail to account for tax receipt payments, resulting in false claims of outstanding dues and unnecessary harassment.

The construction quality is shockingly poor and well below acceptable standards, completely disproportional to the prices charged. What is most disappointing is that despite being a listed company, their processes, transparency, and customer handling are no better than those of an unprofessional local trader, with no accountability or basic systems in place.

To top it all off, they do not even allow customers to view their own unit, which is unacceptable and raises serious concerns about customer rights and ethics.

Overall, this is a vert average project as builder demonstrates poor construction quality and ethics, weak financial controls, lack of transparency, and complete disregard for customers. I would strongly advise extreme caution before engaging with them. There are much better projects in the vicinity and south Mumbai than investing in any of the Lodha projects, that delivers bad quality and match box sizes by cutting corners.

featured_reviews.name: Satyam Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Lodha World Towers, located in the heart of Mumbai, is an iconic luxury residential development that has redefined the city’s skyline. Comprising three ultra-modern skyscrapers, this project by the Lodha Group offers a mix of residences and amenities tailored to those who seek an elevated lifestyle.

Architectural Marvel
Lodha World Towers stands out as a marvel of modern architecture. Designed by the renowned firm Pei Cobb Freed & Partners, the buildings feature a sleek, futuristic look with a glass façade and dynamic lighting that adds a distinctive touch to Mumbai’s skyline. The structure's careful design and engineering give it a bold, towering presence.

Interiors and Layout
Inside, the residences exude luxury and attention to detail. Each apartment is crafted with high-end materials, spacious layouts, and large windows that provide expansive views of the Arabian Sea and Mumbai cityscape. The interiors are elegant, with state-of-the-art fittings and amenities. The ceiling heights, quality of finishes, and thoughtful designs add to the comfort and prestige of each residence.

Amenities
Lodha World Towers is known for its extensive range of amenities that cater to every age and interest. The complex includes a private movie theater, infinity pool, spa, fitness center, children’s play area, and various sports facilities. For nature lovers, there’s also a landscaped garden and outdoor spaces that provide a peaceful escape from city life. The hospitality and concierge services are comparable to five-star hotels, ensuring residents experience convenience at every turn.

Location
Situated in Lower Parel, one of Mumbai’s prime locations, Lodha World Towers offers excellent connectivity to key parts of the city. It’s near major business districts, luxury shopping centers, and some of the city’s best dining and entertainment options. This location is ideal for professionals, families, and expatriates alike, as it blends convenience with a premium urban lifestyle.

Community and Lifestyle
Living at Lodha World Towers offers a sense of exclusivity and community among like-minded individuals. The towers attract a diverse, high-profile clientele, making it a desirable address for networking and socializing. Regular events, gatherings, and community spaces add to the vibrant lifestyle within the towers.

Overall Impression
Lodha World Towers is a world-class residential development that sets a new benchmark for luxury living in Mumbai. With its impressive architecture, premium interiors, unmatched amenities, and central location, it offers a highly attractive option for those seeking the finest in urban living. While it comes with a premium price, the lifestyle, comfort, and prestige it provides make it worth the investment for those who can afford it.
